card.name: Linking words before Nazi-era names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (of, and, to, by, as) right before a named historical person, mostly Nazi-era figures like Himmler, Hitler, Röhm, Goering. The next word is expected to be a proper name.

modes.label: Link before a leader's name
modes.description: A word like of, by, or on sits just before a Nazi figure's name.
modes.example: which was initially intended to be Hitler's bodyguard under the leadership<< of>> Himmler

modes.label: Comma or and in a name list
modes.description: A comma or and sits between titles and the next person's name.
modes.example: Third Reich architechs, Heinrich Himmler<<,>> Hermann Goering and Rudolf Hess

modes.label: Other named figures
modes.description: The same kind of link appears before a named person or mythic figure outside the Nazi setting.
